AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Small Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
